content_sections.heading: ESIC Kollam Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 27 contractual vacancies are available across three post categories: Super Specialist, Specialist, and Senior Resident. The notification clarifies that in case of non-availability of candidates in the advertised category, a post may be filled for 44 days with a UR (Unreserved) candidate. Note: The Senior Resident section heading in the official notification reads "13 Vacancies," while the vacancy table and the explicit "No. of vacancies" field both state the total as 17 (Seventeen). This article follows the table total and the explicitly stated figure of 17, as given in the source document.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kollam Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements differ by post and department. Candidates should check the qualification, experience, and age limit applicable to the specific post and speciality they wish to apply for. For Superspeciality departments, DM/DrNB in the concerned superspeciality is preferred over MD/DNB in General Medicine. For Specialty departments, a Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in the concerned speciality after MBBS with TCMC registration is required. ICU: PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Emergency Medicine/Critical Care Medicine, registered with the Medical Council. Casualty: PG Degree in Emergency Medicine is preferred. In its absence, PG degree or PG diploma holders in Anaesthesiology/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Critical Care Medicine registered with the Medical Council will be considered. In the absence of postgraduate qualifications, MBBS doctors with at least two years' experience in the concerned speciality and registered with the Medical Council may be selected for the Casualty department. Candidates who have already completed Senior Residency for 3 years in any Central Institutions are not eligible for the post of Senior Resident. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

rows.qualification_experience_required: A recognised medical qualification included in the first or second Schedule, or Part-II of the third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications), to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956; plus MCh/DM/DNB or equivalent in the concerned super specialty. All postgraduate additional qualifications must be registered with the Medical Council.
Same basic qualification as above, plus at least five years of post super-specialty qualification experience.

Experience: 3 years in the respective specialty for degree holders, or 5 years for diploma holders.
Same qualification as above. Experience: 5 years in the respective specialty for degree holders, or 7 years for diploma holders.

rows.age_limit: Not exceeding 69 years as on the date of interview. Tenure beyond 70 years is not allowed.
Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview. Age relaxation for SC, ST & OBC candidates as per rules.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Kollam Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for all posts will be based on qualification, experience, and a walk-in interview. The interview will be conducted at ESIC Model & Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam. Candidates belonging to OBC/SC/ST categories must produce a valid caste certificate issued by the Tahsildar/Revenue Divisional Officer; OBC certificates must confirm the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer, and EWS certificates must be valid and issued in the prescribed government format. Candidates applying under the PWD category must possess a disability certificate issued by a duly constituted Medical Board of a State or Central Government hospital/institution. The appointing authority reserves the right to terminate the service of an appointee at any time, even before completion of tenure, without assigning any reason, by giving one month's notice, or immediately in case of disciplinary action. Similarly, the engaged person must give one month's prior notice before resigning or pay an amount equivalent to one month's remuneration in lieu of notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (Advertisement No. 07/2026) to fill contractual posts of Super Specialist, Specialist, and Senior Resident at ESIC Model & Super Specialty Hospital, Asramam, Kollam, Kerala, through a walk-in interview on 03.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 27 total vacancies: 3 for Super Specialist, 7 for Specialist, and 17 for Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify a last date to apply, as this is a walk-in interview. Candidates must report in person on 03.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ESIC Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post: Super Specialist posts require MCh/DM/DNB or equivalent; Specialist posts require a PG Degree/DNB or Diploma after MBBS/BDS; Senior Resident posts require a PG Degree/DNB or Diploma after MBBS, with specific requirements for ICU and Casualty departments. Full details are given in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 69 years (not exceeding) for Super Specialist and Specialist posts, and 45 years (not exceeding) for Senior Resident posts, as on the date of interview. SC/ST/OBC candidates get age relaxation as per rules for the Senior Resident post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Kollam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 250/- for General, EWS, and OBC candidates, and Rs. 50/- for SC/ST candidates, payable by Demand Draft. PWD and female applicants are exempted.
